reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing isSkippedByMonthWideAction predicate and getMonthWideCategories selector that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed in one predicate; each action only forwards its argument.

placement.why: All changes sit in budget/actions.ts next to the shared exclusion predicate, and handler types pick up the new argument via typeof.

scope.why: Only the predicate, selector, action signatures, a comment and a release note change.

maintainability.why: One defaulted parameter on the shared predicate keeps the rule in a single place and leaves the default behaviour unchanged.
